comparison.objective: Extend a suitcase handle past an intermediate stop and lock both rails at full height.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain button depression while pulling a telescoping mechanism and stabilizing the case.
comparison.success_condition: Handle at 520±3 mm with both locks engaged, case retained near its start, and hands clear for 1 second.
comparison.reason: Tests coordinated latch operation and telescoping extraction, not tool-mediated size separation or granular-flow control.
